items.exampleEn: This karaoke machine shows the words on the TV screen as the music plays.
items.exampleZh: 這部卡拉 OK 機會在音樂播放時，把歌詞顯示在電視螢幕上。

items.exampleEn: The young impressionist painted the same bridge at different times of day.
items.exampleZh: 那位年輕的印象派畫家在一天中的不同時刻畫同一座橋。

items.exampleEn: The film's orchestral music made the final scene very moving.
items.exampleZh: 電影的交響配樂讓最後一幕非常感人。

items.exampleEn: I updated my bio after I changed jobs last month.
items.exampleZh: 上個月換工作後，我更新了自己的個人簡介。

items.exampleEn: The kitchen maestro prepared a ten-course dinner for the guests.
items.exampleZh: 那位廚藝大師為客人準備了十道菜的晚宴。

items.exampleEn: For the festival, workers stretched a tightrope between two tall buildings.
items.exampleZh: 為了慶典，工人在兩棟高樓之間拉起一條鋼索。
items.glossZh: 鋼索；（比喻）如履薄冰的處境

items.exampleEn: Fans idolize the singer so much that they copy her clothes.
items.exampleZh: 歌迷非常崇拜那位歌手，甚至模仿她的穿著。

items.exampleEn: The cellist tuned her instrument quietly before the concert.
items.exampleZh: 音樂會開始前，大提琴手安靜地調音。

items.sentenceEn: The circus act ended with a man riding a bicycle on a tightrope.
items.sentenceZh: 馬戲表演最後是一位男士在鋼索上騎腳踏車。

items.audioEn: The karaoke room is booked from eight to ten, and the price includes snacks.
items.audioZh: 卡拉 OK 包廂訂了八點到十點，價格含點心。

items.sentenceEn: Monet is one of the most famous impressionist painters.
items.sentenceZh: 莫內是最有名的印象派畫家之一。

items.sentenceEn: Many young musicians idolize the great jazz players of the past.
items.sentenceZh: 很多年輕音樂家崇拜過去的爵士樂大師。

items.stemEn: The ____ bowed to the orchestra and then raised his stick to begin.
items.stemZh: 那位名指揮家向樂團鞠躬，接著舉起指揮棒開始。

items.stemEn: Before the show, the singer's short ____ was printed in the program.
items.stemZh: 演出前，歌手的簡短介紹印在節目單上。

items.passageEn: My aunt is a professional cellist, and her life is never boring. During the day, she practices for her orchestral concerts, and even while doing the laundry she listens to recordings. Her bio on the orchestra's website says she started playing at age six because she idolized a famous cellist she saw on TV. Last month, she played under a world-famous maestro, which she called a dream come true. Her free time is just as colorful: she visits galleries to see impressionist paintings and goes to karaoke with friends on Friday nights. She says balancing work and fun is like walking a tightrope, but she loves every minute of it. She often reminds me that improving any skill takes years of practice.
items.passageZh: 我阿姨是職業大提琴手，她的生活從不無聊。白天，她為樂團音樂會練習，連洗衣服時都在聽錄音。樂團網站上她的簡介寫著，她六歲開始拉琴，因為她崇拜一位在電視上看到的知名大提琴家。上個月，她在一位世界知名的指揮大師指揮下演出，她說那是夢想成真。她的閒暇時光一樣精彩：她會去美術館看印象派畫作，星期五晚上也會和朋友去唱卡拉 OK。她說要兼顧工作和玩樂就像走鋼索，但她享受每一分鐘。她常提醒我，任何技能要進步都得花好幾年練習。

questions.questionZh: 阿姨為什麼六歲開始拉大提琴？
options: 父母希望她學一種樂器
學校規定要學一種樂器
她在嘉年華聽到大提琴演奏

questions.questionZh: 阿姨說兼顧工作和玩樂像什麼？

items.promptZh: 我們昨晚在卡拉 OK 唱到午夜。
referenceEn: We sang karaoke until midnight last night.
Last night we did karaoke until midnight.
rubricZh: karaoke 可搭配不同動詞，例如 sing karaoke、do karaoke、go to karaoke 等
有 last night 時間標記，用過去式

items.promptZh: 這首流行歌的交響樂版本比原曲還受歡迎。
referenceEn: The orchestral version of this pop song is more popular than the original.
This pop song's orchestral version has become more popular than the original one.
rubricZh: orchestral 是形容詞，放名詞前（例如 the orchestral version 等）
「比原曲還受歡迎」用比較級（例如 more popular than the original 等）
時態可用現在式或現在完成式（例如 is、has become 等）
